questions.text: What is the purpose of a residual (skip) connection in a transformer block?
options: To reduce the number of trainable parameters
To add the input to the output: y = x + f(x)
To completely replace the self-attention mechanism in the block
To increase the maximum sequence length
questions.explanation: Residual connections add the input to the sub-layer output: y = x + Attention(x). This provides a gradient highway, preventing vanishing gradients in deep networks.

questions.text: Where does Layer Normalization (pre-norm) go in a transformer block?
options: Before the sub-layer: Attention(LayerNorm(x))
After the entire transformer block has finished computing
Only during inference, never while training
Between the multi-head attention and dropout
questions.explanation: Pre-norm applies LayerNorm before each sub-layer. GPT-2 and most modern LLMs use pre-norm because it provides more stable training dynamics.

questions.text: What does the complete AttentionBlock combine?
options: Only the multi-head attention computation
Attention plus the feed-forward network, and nothing else besides
LayerNorm, causal multi-head attention, dropout, residual
The tokenizer and the token embedding layer
questions.explanation: The AttentionBlock wraps: LayerNorm -> MultiHead Causal Self-Attention -> Dropout -> Residual Add. This is one half of a full transformer block (the other half is the feed-forward network).

questions.text: Which concepts from Stage 3 are combined in the final attention module?Select all that apply
options: Scaled dot-product attention (L13)
Causal masking (L15)
Byte-pair encoding tokenization of the raw input text (L8)
Multi-head splitting (L16)
questions.explanation: The final attention module combines scaled dot-product attention, QKV projections, causal masking, and multi-head splitting. Tokenization belongs to Stage 2.

questions.text: What comes after Stage 3 (Attention) in building a GPT model?
options: Immediately training the completed model on the dataset
Deploying the model straight to a production environment
Adding several additional attention-only layers on top of it
Stage 4: add the FFN, stack blocks, add the output head
questions.explanation: Stage 4 adds the feed-forward network, stacks multiple transformer blocks, and adds the language model output head to complete the GPT architecture.

questions.text: Care este scopul unei conexiuni reziduale (skip) într-un bloc transformer?
options: Reducerea numărului de parametri antrenabili
Adăugarea intrării la ieșire: y = x + f(x)
Înlocuirea completă a mecanismului de self-attention din bloc
Creșterea lungimii maxime a secvenței
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Conexiunile reziduale adaugă intrarea la ieșirea sub-stratului: y = x + Attention(x). Aceasta oferă o autostradă pentru gradienți, prevenind dispariția gradienților în rețele adânci.

questions.text: Unde se plasează Layer Normalization (pre-norm) într-un bloc transformer?
options: Înainte de sub-strat: Attention(LayerNorm(x))
După ce întregul bloc transformer a terminat de calculat
Doar în timpul inferenței, niciodată la antrenare
Între multi-head attention și stratul de dropout
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Pre-norm aplică LayerNorm înainte de fiecare sub-strat. GPT-2 și cele mai multe LLM-uri moderne folosesc pre-norm deoarece oferă o dinamică de antrenare mai stabilă.

questions.text: Ce combină AttentionBlock complet?
options: Doar calculul de multi-head attention
Attention plus rețeaua feed-forward și nimic altceva în plus pe lângă
LayerNorm, self-attention cauzal multi-head, dropout, rezidual
Tokenizer-ul și stratul de embedding al token-urilor
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: AttentionBlock învelește: LayerNorm -> Self-Attention Cauzal Multi-Head -> Dropout -> Adunare Reziduală. Aceasta este o jumătate dintr-un bloc transformer complet (cealaltă jumătate este rețeaua feed-forward).

questions.text: Ce concepte din Etapa 3 sunt combinate în modulul final de attention? Selectați toate răspunsurile corecte
options: Attention cu produs scalar scalat (L13)
Mascare cauzală (L15)
Tokenizare byte-pair encoding a textului brut de intrare (L8)
Împărțire multi-head (L16)
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Modulul final de attention combină attention-ul cu produs scalar scalat, proiecțiile QKV, mascarea cauzală și împărțirea multi-head. Tokenizarea aparține Etapei 2.

questions.text: Ce urmează după Etapa 3 (Attention) în construirea unui model GPT?
options: Antrenarea imediată a modelului finalizat pe setul de date
Implementarea modelului direct într-un mediu de producție
Adăugarea mai multor straturi suplimentare doar de attention deasupra
Etapa 4: adaugă FFN, stivuiește blocuri, adaugă capul de ieșire
questions.explanation: ✅ Explicație: Etapa 4 adaugă rețeaua feed-forward, stivuiește mai multe blocuri transformer și adaugă capul de ieșire al modelului de limbaj pentru a completa arhitectura GPT.

questions.text: Ποιος είναι ο σκοπός μιας υπολειμματικής (skip) σύνδεσης σε ένα μπλοκ transformer;
options: Μείωση του αριθμού των εκπαιδεύσιμων παραμέτρων
Πρόσθεση της εισόδου στην έξοδο: y = x + f(x)
Πλήρης αντικατάσταση του μηχανισμού self-attention στο μπλοκ
Αύξηση του μέγιστου μήκους της ακολουθίας
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Οι υπολειμματικές συνδέσεις προσθέτουν την είσοδο στην έξοδο του υποεπιπέδου: y = x + Attention(x). Αυτό παρέχει μια λεωφόρο κλίσεων, αποτρέποντας τις εξαφανιζόμενες κλίσεις σε βαθιά δίκτυα.

questions.text: Πού τοποθετείται η Layer Normalization (pre-norm) σε ένα μπλοκ transformer;
options: Πριν το υποεπίπεδο: Attention(LayerNorm(x))
Αφού ολοκληρωθεί ο υπολογισμός ολόκληρου του μπλοκ transformer
Μόνο κατά την εξαγωγή συμπερασμάτων, ποτέ στην εκπαίδευση
Μεταξύ του multi-head attention και του dropout
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Το pre-norm εφαρμόζει LayerNorm πριν από κάθε υποεπίπεδο. Το GPT-2 και τα περισσότερα σύγχρονα LLMs χρησιμοποιούν pre-norm επειδή παρέχει πιο σταθερή δυναμική εκπαίδευσης.

questions.text: Τι συνδυάζει το πλήρες AttentionBlock;
options: Μόνο τον υπολογισμό multi-head attention
Attention και δίκτυο feed-forward και τίποτα άλλο πέρα από αυτά
LayerNorm, αιτιατό multi-head attention, dropout, υπόλειμμα
Τον tokenizer και το επίπεδο embedding των token
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Το AttentionBlock περιτυλίγει: LayerNorm -> Αιτιατό Self-Attention Πολλαπλών Κεφαλιών -> Dropout -> Υπολειμματική Πρόσθεση. Αυτό είναι το μισό ενός πλήρους μπλοκ transformer (το άλλο μισό είναι το δίκτυο feed-forward).

questions.text: Ποιες έννοιες από το Στάδιο 3 συνδυάζονται στο τελικό μονάδα attention; Επιλέξτε όλες τις σωστές απαντήσεις
options: Κλιμακωτό attention εσωτερικού γινομένου (L13)
Αιτιατή μάσκα (L15)
Tokenization byte-pair encoding του ακατέργαστου κειμένου εισόδου (L8)
Διαχωρισμός πολλαπλών κεφαλιών (L16)
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Η τελική μονάδα attention συνδυάζει κλιμακωτό attention εσωτερικού γινομένου, προβολές QKV, αιτιατή μάσκα και διαχωρισμό πολλαπλών κεφαλιών. Η τεκμηρίωση ανήκει στο Στάδιο 2.

questions.text: Τι ακολουθεί μετά το Στάδιο 3 (Attention) στην κατασκευή ενός μοντέλου GPT;
options: Άμεση εκπαίδευση του ολοκληρωμένου μοντέλου στο σύνολο δεδομένων
Ανάπτυξη του μοντέλου απευθείας σε περιβάλλον παραγωγής
Προσθήκη αρκετών επιπλέον επιπέδων μόνο attention από πάνω του
Στάδιο 4: προσθήκη FFN, στοίβαξη μπλοκ, προσθήκη κεφαλής εξόδου
questions.explanation: ✅ Εξήγηση: Το Στάδιο 4 προσθέτει το δίκτυο feed-forward, στοιβάζει πολλαπλά μπλοκ transformer και προσθέτει την κεφαλή εξόδου γλωσσικού μοντέλου για να ολοκληρώσει την αρχιτεκτονική GPT.

questions.text: Was ist der Zweck einer Residual- (Skip-)Verbindung in einem Transformer-Block?
options: Die Anzahl der trainierbaren Parameter zu reduzieren
Die Eingabe zur Ausgabe zu addieren: y = x + f(x)
Den Self-Attention-Mechanismus im Block vollständig zu ersetzen
Die maximale Sequenzlänge zu erhöhen
questions.explanation: Residualverbindungen addieren die Eingabe zur Ausgabe der Teilschicht: y = x + Attention(x). Dies bietet eine Gradienten-Autobahn und verhindert verschwindende Gradienten in tiefen Netzwerken.

questions.text: Wo befindet sich die Layer-Normalisierung (Pre-Norm) in einem Transformer-Block?
options: Vor der Teilschicht: Attention(LayerNorm(x))
Nachdem der gesamte Transformer-Block seine Berechnung abgeschlossen hat
Nur während der Inferenz, niemals während des Trainings
Zwischen der Multi-Head-Attention und dem Dropout
questions.explanation: Pre-Norm wendet LayerNorm vor jeder Teilschicht an. GPT-2 und die meisten modernen LLMs verwenden Pre-Norm, da es eine stabilere Trainingsdynamik bietet.

questions.text: Was kombiniert der vollständige AttentionBlock?
options: Nur die Multi-Head-Attention-Berechnung
Attention plus das Feed-Forward-Netzwerk, und sonst nichts
LayerNorm, kausale Multi-Head-Attention, Dropout, Residual
Den Tokenizer und die Token-Embedding-Schicht
questions.explanation: Der AttentionBlock bettet ein: LayerNorm -> Multi-Head kausale Self-Attention -> Dropout -> Residual-Addition. Dies ist eine Hälfte eines vollständigen Transformer-Blocks (die andere Hälfte ist das Feed-Forward-Netzwerk).

questions.text: Welche Konzepte aus Stufe 3 werden im finalen Attention-Modul kombiniert? Wählen Sie alle zutreffenden Antworten
options: Skaliertes Skalarprodukt-Attention (L13)
Kausale Maskierung (L15)
Byte-Pair-Encoding-Tokenisierung des rohen Eingabetexts (L8)
Multi-Head-Aufteilung (L16)
questions.explanation: Das finale Attention-Modul kombiniert skaliertes Skalarprodukt-Attention, QKV-Projektionen, kausale Maskierung und Multi-Head-Aufteilung. Tokenisierung gehört zu Stufe 2.

questions.text: Was folgt nach Stufe 3 (Attention) beim Aufbau eines GPT-Modells?
options: Das fertige Modell sofort auf dem Datensatz zu trainieren
Das Modell direkt in eine Produktionsumgebung zu bringen
Mehrere zusätzliche reine Attention-Schichten obendrauf hinzuzufügen
Stufe 4: das FFN hinzufügen, Blöcke stapeln, den Ausgabekopf hinzufügen
questions.explanation: Stufe 4 fügt das Feed-Forward-Netzwerk hinzu, stapelt mehrere Transformer-Blöcke und fügt den Sprachmodell-Ausgabekopf hinzu, um die GPT-Architektur zu vervollständigen.

questions.text: Quel est le but d'une connexion résiduelle (skip connection) dans un bloc de transformer ?
options: Réduire le nombre de paramètres entraînables
Ajouter l'entrée à la sortie : y = x + f(x)
Remplacer complètement le mécanisme d'auto-attention dans le bloc
Augmenter la longueur maximale de séquence
questions.explanation: Les connexions résiduelles ajoutent l'entrée à la sortie de la sous-couche : y = x + Attention(x). Cela offre une autoroute pour les gradients, empêchant leur disparition dans les réseaux profonds.

questions.text: Où se place la normalisation par couche (Layer Normalization, pre-norm) dans un bloc de transformer ?
options: Avant la sous-couche : Attention(LayerNorm(x))
Après que tout le bloc de transformer a fini son calcul
Uniquement pendant l'inférence, jamais pendant l'entraînement
Entre l'attention multi-têtes et le dropout
questions.explanation: Pre-norm applique la normalisation par couche avant chaque sous-couche. GPT-2 et la plupart des LLM modernes utilisent pre-norm car cela offre une dynamique d'entraînement plus stable.

questions.text: Qu'est-ce que le bloc AttentionBlock complet combine-t-il ?
options: Uniquement le calcul de l'attention multi-têtes
L'attention plus le réseau feed-forward, et rien d'autre en dehors de cela
LayerNorm, attention multi-têtes causale, dropout, résiduel
Le tokenizer et la couche d'embedding des tokens
questions.explanation: Le bloc AttentionBlock enveloppe : LayerNorm -> auto-attention causale multi-têtes -> Dropout -> ajout résiduel. C'est une moitié d'un bloc de transformer complet (l'autre moitié étant le réseau feed-forward).

questions.text: Quels concepts de l'étape 3 sont combinés dans le module d'attention final ? Sélectionnez toutes les réponses applicables
options: Attention par produit scalaire mis à l'échelle (cours 13)
Masquage causal (cours 15)
Tokenisation par encodage par paires d'octets (BPE) du texte brut d'entrée (cours 8)
Division multi-têtes (cours 16)
questions.explanation: Le module d'attention final combine l'attention par produit scalaire mis à l'échelle, les projections QKV, le masquage causal et la division multi-têtes. La tokenisation appartient à l'étape 2.

questions.text: Que vient-il après l'étape 3 (Attention) dans la construction d'un modèle GPT ?
options: Entraîner immédiatement le modèle terminé sur le jeu de données
Déployer le modèle directement en environnement de production
Ajouter plusieurs couches supplémentaires d'attention seule par-dessus
Étape 4 : ajouter le FFN, empiler les blocs, ajouter la tête de sortie
questions.explanation: L'étape 4 ajoute le réseau feed-forward, empile plusieurs blocs de transformer, et ajoute la tête de sortie du modèle de langage pour compléter l'architecture GPT.

questions.text: Qual è lo scopo di una connessione residua (skip) in un blocco transformer?
options: Ridurre il numero di parametri addestrabili
Aggiungere l'input all'output: y = x + f(x)
Sostituire completamente il meccanismo di self-attention nel blocco
Aumentare la lunghezza massima della sequenza
questions.explanation: Le connessioni residue aggiungono l'input all'output del sub-layer: y = x + Attention(x). Questo fornisce un'autostrada del gradiente, prevenendo il vanishing gradient nelle reti profonde.

questions.text: Dove si colloca la Layer Normalization (pre-norm) in un blocco transformer?
options: Prima del sub-layer: Attention(LayerNorm(x))
Dopo che l'intero blocco transformer ha terminato il calcolo
Solo durante l'inferenza, mai durante l'addestramento
Tra la multi-head attention e il dropout
questions.explanation: Il pre-norm applica la LayerNorm prima di ciascun sub-layer. GPT-2 e la maggior parte degli LLM moderni utilizzano il pre-norm perché offre dinamiche di addestramento più stabili.

questions.text: Cosa combina l'AttentionBlock completo?
options: Solo il calcolo della multi-head attention
L'attention più la rete feed-forward, e nient'altro
LayerNorm, multi-head attention causale, dropout, residual
Il tokenizer e il layer di embedding dei token
questions.explanation: L'AttentionBlock racchiude: LayerNorm -> MultiHead Causal Self-Attention -> Dropout -> Residual Add. Questa è metà di un blocco transformer completo (l'altra metà è la rete feed-forward).

questions.text: Quali concetti della Fase 3 vengono combinati nel modulo di attention finale? Seleziona tutte le risposte corrette
options: Scaled dot-product attention (L13)
Mascheramento causale (L15)
Tokenizzazione byte-pair encoding del testo di input grezzo (L8)
Suddivisione multi-head (L16)
questions.explanation: Il modulo di attention finale combina scaled dot-product attention, proiezioni QKV, mascheramento causale e suddivisione multi-head. La tokenizzazione appartiene alla Fase 2.

questions.text: Cosa segue la Fase 3 (Attention) nella costruzione di un modello GPT?
options: Addestrare immediatamente il modello completato sul dataset
Distribuire il modello direttamente in un ambiente di produzione
Aggiungere sopra di esso diversi ulteriori layer di sola attention
Fase 4: aggiungere la FFN, impilare i blocchi, aggiungere la testa di output
questions.explanation: La Fase 4 aggiunge la rete feed-forward, impila più blocchi transformer e aggiunge la testa di output del modello linguistico per completare l'architettura GPT.

questions.text: ما الغرض من الاتصال المتبقي (residual/skip connection) في كتلة transformer؟
options: تقليل عدد المعاملات القابلة للتدريب
إضافة المدخل إلى المخرج: y = x + f(x)
استبدال آلية self-attention في الكتلة بالكامل
زيادة الطول الأقصى للتسلسل
questions.explanation: تضيف الاتصالات المتبقية المدخل إلى مخرج الطبقة الفرعية: y = x + Attention(x). يوفر هذا طريقًا سريعًا للتدرجات، مما يمنع تلاشي التدرجات في الشبكات العميقة.

questions.text: أين يوضع تطبيع الطبقات (Layer Normalization) في نمط pre-norm داخل كتلة transformer؟
options: قبل الطبقة الفرعية: Attention(LayerNorm(x))
بعد أن تنتهي كتلة transformer بأكملها من الحساب
فقط أثناء الاستدلال، أبدًا أثناء التدريب
بين multi-head attention وطبقة dropout
questions.explanation: يطبّق pre-norm عملية LayerNorm قبل كل طبقة فرعية. يستخدم GPT-2 ومعظم نماذج اللغة الكبيرة الحديثة pre-norm لأنه يوفر ديناميكيات تدريب أكثر استقرارًا.

questions.text: ماذا تجمع كتلة AttentionBlock الكاملة؟
options: حساب multi-head attention فقط
attention بالإضافة إلى شبكة feed-forward، ولا شيء غير ذلك
LayerNorm، وmulti-head causal self-attention، وdropout، والاتصال المتبقي
أداة الترميز (tokenizer) وطبقة تضمين الرموز (token embedding)
questions.explanation: تحيط كتلة AttentionBlock بما يلي: LayerNorm ثم multi-head causal self-attention ثم dropout ثم الجمع المتبقي (residual add). هذا يمثّل نصف كتلة transformer كاملة (النصف الآخر هو شبكة feed-forward).

questions.text: ما المفاهيم من المرحلة 3 التي تُجمع في وحدة attention النهائية؟ اختر كل ما ينطبق
options: Scaled dot-product attention (المحاضرة 13)
القناع السببي causal masking (المحاضرة 15)
ترميز Byte-pair encoding لنص الإدخال الخام (المحاضرة 8)
التقسيم متعدد الرؤوس multi-head splitting (المحاضرة 16)
questions.explanation: تجمع وحدة attention النهائية بين scaled dot-product attention، وإسقاطات QKV، والقناع السببي، والتقسيم متعدد الرؤوس. أما الترميز (tokenization) فينتمي إلى المرحلة 2.

questions.text: ماذا يأتي بعد المرحلة 3 (Attention) في بناء نموذج GPT؟
options: تدريب النموذج المكتمل مباشرة على مجموعة البيانات
نشر النموذج مباشرة في بيئة إنتاج
إضافة عدة طبقات إضافية قائمة على attention فقط فوقه
المرحلة 4: إضافة FFN، وتكديس الكتل، وإضافة رأس المخرج
questions.explanation: تضيف المرحلة 4 شبكة feed-forward، وتُكدّس عدة كتل transformer، وتضيف رأس مخرج نموذج اللغة لإكمال بنية GPT.
